description: SvListBox and SvDropDownList scaling to 50,000 options in Svelte 5 with the virtual prop: only the visible rows exist in the DOM, rows are recycled on scroll with no mount and unmount churn, grouped lists window too with their headings, and rowHeight can be a function for variable heights. Scrolling and type-ahead stay instant, and a custom itemTemplate renders an avatar and role per row.

faq.question: What changes when I add virtual?
faq.answer: Nothing in the API. The list renders only the rows in view plus a small buffer and recycles them as you scroll, so a list of fifty thousand options costs the same as one of fifty.

faq.question: Do grouped lists virtualize?
faq.answer: Yes. Group headings are part of the windowed rows, so they scroll into view like options and type-ahead still jumps across groups.

faq.question: Can rows have different heights?
faq.answer: Yes. Pass rowHeight as a function of the option and the virtualizer uses the per-row size.
